env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w
logos build ./...
logos run ./main
stdout '^ada unset$'
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/twolevelopt

go 1.27

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "comptime"

type Profile struct {
	Nick string?
	Tag  string?
}

func Render[T any](v T) string {
	return Show[T](v)
}

func Show[T any](v T) string {
	s := ""
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		const if f.Index != 0 {
			s = s + " "
		}
		s = s + Cell(v.[f])
	}
	return s
}

func Cell(v string?) string {
	return v ?? "unset"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"example.com/twolevelopt/lib"
	"fmt"
)

func main() {
	p := lib.Profile{Nick: "ada"}
	fmt.Println(lib.Render[lib.Profile](p))
}
